title: HenrikoCraft: Skyborne
description: This modpack contains a collecftion of small Q.O.L oriented mods for use on the HenrikoCraft: Skyborne server. Some of the mods included are Sodium, Iris, Fresh Animations, FancyMenu, Distant Horizons and more.
body: This modpack contains a collecftion of small Q.O.L oriented mods for use on the HenrikoCraft: Skyborne server. Some of the mods included are Sodium, Iris, Fresh Animations, FancyMenu, Distant Horizons and more. These help improve performance, visuals and overall usability when playing on the server, such as letting you search for keybinds. It also aims to increase immersion through improved animations, and increased render distances.
